summary: Keep a rental, with the token alone: say you are alive and still holding the card - and name every process your rental put on the card (`processes`): each one's pid, the proof its command line carries - the id of the load that started it (`load-...`), as the runner mints it - the model it runs, its engine, its port, and the memory it uses (`mib`), or null for what is not known. The list is the whole list, and it replaces the one the coordinator has: a heartbeat that was lost is healed by the next, and `[]` says nothing of the rental is on the card any more. A heartbeat without `processes` leaves the list as it was. A process is named from the moment it exists, before its model is up. A rental names at most 8; a proof that is not a load's id, or a pid named twice, is refused `bad_processes`, and nothing is renewed. The coordinator writes a line of its record when the list changes, never one per beat, and keeps when it first heard of each process (`since`). When a rental lapses, the coordinator ends every process it names - each only on its own proof. Refused with a reason when the token holds no rental any more, so a holder learns it lost the card from an answer, never from silence: a holder that cannot reach the coordinator keeps its rental. A coordinator restarted from its record knows the token, and the list, again. A renewal says whether the card is `wanted` - some other ticket is in line for it - and nothing more: never whose, for what, or how many; a holder whose work is done can let the card go at once instead of keeping a model warm. THE WORK, AND A HANG (PLAN-4 D3): a heartbeat may say what the rental's work is doing - `working`, a model of the rental is answering a request now; `progress`, the tokens streamed and the answers ended since the rental was granted: a count only real work moves; `deadline_s`, an answer under way comes in ONE piece (a transcript) and is due within this many seconds of this beat. Answers to different models of a rental run at the same time: `working` while any of them answers, `progress` counts every one's tokens and ends, and `deadline_s` is the latest of the one-piece answers under way. A rental that says it is working, whose progress has not moved for the coordinator's hang limit (`limits.hang_s` on `/state`, 300 s unless it was started with another) - counted from when it began saying so, and never before a deadline it declared - is taken back as a lapsed one is: every process it names ended on its own proof, outside the coordinator's lock, and the record says why (`rental_hung`); its holder is answered `reclaimed`, in words that say why. A heartbeat that does not say `working` is not working: no hang is ever seen for it - a session with nothing to answer holds the card as long as it likes. THE CARD, DEGRADED (D3): `memory_errors` is how many lines of the rental's models' logs, since it was granted, said the card's memory ran out, and `memory_error` the newest of them. A count that rose, or the card's free memory read under the floor (`limits.floor_mib`, 256 MiB unless the coordinator was started with another) by the coordinator's own look at the card during the rental (every `limits.watch_s`, 30 s unless started with another, never under its lock), marks the rental `degraded` - why, in words, and the numbers - and the rental is NOT ended for it: nothing new goes on the card (`/card/amend` refuses `degraded`), its holder's current and next model work fails saying so, and it clears when a later look finds the card has room again. A SLOW ANSWER (D3, D12): `slow_answers` is how many answers of the rental's models, since it was granted, were far slower than their model's own normal - its holder's runner judges each against its own statistics - and `slow_answer` the newest, in words. A count that rose while the card, as the coordinator last read it, had less free than it counts as full (`limits.full_mib`, 1024 MiB unless started with another) marks the rental `degraded` too (`slow_answer`); on a card with room a slow answer is not the card's doing, and is only counted - as it is when the card has not been read. `degraded` is null while the card has room. A count, progress or deadline below zero is refused `bad_work`, and renews nothing.
